# A Whisker Among the Stars

When the first cat arrived on Mars as an accidental stowaway, she discovered that the red dust tasted like rust and starlight, and that loneliness on another planet felt exactly the same as it did back on Earth—until she found a family of curious rovers who had been waiting centuries for someone to purr at them.
